description: This file provides a handler for accessing and searching call logs within an Android app. It defines data structures for call log records and search requests, implements a data source utilizing Android's CallLog content provider, and provides permission checking and JSON-based search handling.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a record in the call log, including phone number, cached name, timestamp, call duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search parameters for querying call logs, including filters like name, number, date range, duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checking and searching call logs.

classes.name: SystemCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of CallLogDataSource that interacts with Android's CallLog content provider.

classes.name: CallLogHandler
classes.description: Main class providing methods to handle call log searches, including permission validation, request parsing, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch
methods.description: Handles a search request for call logs in JSON format, checks permissions, parses request, executes search, and returns JSON result wrapped in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a CallLogSearchRequest object, applying default values and validation.

methods.name: callLogJson
methods.description: Converts a CallLogRecord into a JSON object for API response.
